topic: Modification: definition and procedure (configuration control committee, LMC)
syllabus_extract: Modification: definition and procedure (configuration control committee, LMC). Classification, promulgation and embodiment of modification, accounting of Mod kit, reports and returns, naval service modification (NSM), Modification SOP and concession
specific_objectives: 1.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to understand modification, life categories and flight-testing effect of CG variation and wartime maintenance procedure

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Modification Request Form (MRF) and Configuration Control Log entries; Instructor supervision on form completion accuracy and data verification against LMC directives.
intro_questions: What is the primary definition of an aircraft modification?
Who constitutes the Configuration Control Committee (CCC)?
Why is the Life Maintenance Committee (LMC) critical in modification approval?

development.content:
Definition and scope of modification
Role of Configuration Control Committee
LMC composition and authority
Classification of modifications
Promulgation and embodiment process

Accounting of Modification kits
Reports and returns procedures
Naval Service Modification (NSM)
Modification SOP guidelines
Concession procedures and limits

Life categories and life latitude
Flight-testing effect of CG variation
Wartime maintenance procedures
Log card updation basics
Review of previous life data

summary_questions: Explain the difference between promulgation and embodiment of a modification.
How does a change in Center of Gravity (CG) affect flight testing requirements?
What are the key steps in accounting for a Modification kit upon receipt?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the Modification SOP concession process and identify two critical checks required before embodiment, to be discussed in LP 10 regarding life categories.

pft_rows.syllabus: Life categories, life latitude, review of life, log card updation and (I) NAMO/G/40, (I) NAMO/G/5
pft_rows.references: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
